suite: Native OnityTask Preserve conversion allocation callstacks
profiler: Unity Profiler GC.Alloc metadata with allocation callstacks enabled
measurement: Pending typed native WhenAny conversion only; source setup, callback registration after conversion, completion, and result reads are outside the profiled scope.
sourceKindCheck: The runner reflects OnityTask<int> state and requires OnityWhenAnyTaskSource.
hashScope: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 LF raw report bytes, identical to the Git blob. Windows autocrlf checkout may change the working-tree byte hash.
reproducibility: Two separate pinned Unity Editor batch processes produced byte-identical attribution JSON and passed the controls. The duplicate repeat is omitted from the repository.
interpretation: Callstack sites and byte counts are measured. The preserved source object, bound Complete delegate, and gate object labels are inferred from the pinned C# allocation expressions and constructor body.
scope: Unity 2022 Editor/Mono on Windows for the pending typed conversion slice. This does not measure Player IL2CPP, device allocation, full task lifecycle, or universal library performance.
